title: Appearance variant (PROPOSAL aigg.appearance-variant/0.1, NONAUTHORITATIVE)
description: PROPOSAL from the T0 ADR. One variant of one person: other drawn-on clothes, hair or expression. It refers to one identity revision. Adding or changing a variant does not change the identity record or its digest. Each variant gives one complete character package. Removable equipment is never a variant (D25). Cross rules (not in JSON Schema): each identity revision has one variant with the id base, and changes refer only to traits with locked false.

identity.description: The identity revision that this variant belongs to.
